Res.Caption: Agents Reference
Res.FullDescription: A reference number allocated by a Customs Broker to a Declaration. Example: Broker's office file number.

Res.Caption: Message
Res.FullDescription: Select the Messaging system to be used.

Res.Caption: Container Mode
Res.FullDescription: The Container mode for the declaration. An identifier to identify whether the cargo is containerized, non-containerized, bulk.

Res.Caption: Estimated Time / Date of Arrival Date at the Final Destination Port
Res.FullDescription: Estimated Time / Date of Arrival at the Final Destination Port.

Res.Caption: Estimated Departure Date At Origin Port
Arrival Date at First Port of Arrival
Res.FullDescription: The Date of Importation at the First Port of Arrival.

Res.Caption: [65] Allowable Discount
Res.FullDescription: [65] Allowable Discount percent.

Res.Caption: Export Goods Type
Res.FullDescription: Type of goods that are being exported e.g. Stores, Spares, General Cargo.

Res.Caption: Folio
Res.FullDescription: A unique number allocated to the flight, at a stated port, where the goods are Discharged.

Res.Caption: Branch Code
Res.FullDescription: The 3 character code of the Company Branch responsible for this job.

Res.Caption: Goods Description
Res.FullDescription: Plain language description of the nature of the goods sufficient to identify the goods at the level required for transport, banking, Customs or statistical purposes.

Res.Caption: Broker
Res.FullDescription: The initials of the assigned Customs Broker who is responsible for this Declaration.

Res.Caption: House Bill
Res.FullDescription: House Bill of shipment

Res.Caption: ICS
Res.FullDescription: Import Clearance Status.

Res.Caption: SOE
Res.FullDescription: Status of Entry.

Res.Caption: Master Bill
Res.FullDescription: Master Bill of the consignment.

Res.Caption: Merge By
Res.FullDescription: Select from the Merge or Non Merge Invoice Lines methods for customs declaration purposes. The purpose of merging invoice lines is to create the least amount of Entry Lines for Declaration messages which in some Countries is a mandatory requirement. A Company level setting for the commercial invoice line merge method is available in the system registry.

Res.Caption: Declaration Type
Res.FullDescription: Input or select the type of Declaration for messaging purposes.

Res.Caption: Shipment Type
Res.FullDescription: Indicates the type of Customs Declaration to be created. It identifies which Customs Document Type or Message Type the declaration details represents by a Party concerning Goods that may cross the border.

Res.Caption: Owners Reference
Res.FullDescription: A reference number allocated by the Owner of the goods for a declaration. Example: a reference number, order number/s or the unique file number. The reference allocated by the Importer / Exporter and used by them to identify the declaration. A system level registry setting can populate the Owners reference field with Order Number/s if required.

Res.Caption: Paid By
Res.FullDescription: Indicate who is paying the customs charges like duty and taxes.The party can either be the Broker (BRK) or the Client (CLI of the broker or any party other than the broker).

Res.Caption: Payment Party
Res.FullDescription: Select the party responsible for the payment of all declaration charges including customs duties, taxes and declaration fees.

Res.Caption: Port Of Final Destination
Res.FullDescription: Intended final arrival point of a shipment. The final destination of goods in a shipment.

Res.Caption: Port Of Origin
Res.FullDescription: Place where the shipment actually originated (began its journey towards its destination).

Res.Caption: Port Of First Arrival
Res.FullDescription: The First Port at which the Vessel/Craft will arrive at in the Discharge Country.

Res.Caption: Port Of Loading
Res.FullDescription: The place where shipments are loaded and secured aboard a vessel/craft. It may or may not be the same as the Port of Origin.

Res.Caption: Service
Res.FullDescription: Select the Service Level for this Declaration.

Res.Caption: Goods Origin
Res.FullDescription: Country of Origin of the goods.

Res.Caption: Incoterm
Res.FullDescription: Enter the Incoterm indicated on the Air Waybill or Bill of Lading. This Incoterm is distinct from the Incoterm/s indicated on the Commercial Invoice/s. It identifies the Incoterm for any freight related costs for the shipment.

Res.Caption: No. Packages
Res.FullDescription: Enter the total number of packages for this shipment, as distinct from the number of units. The total number of packages is what the goods are packed into and the type of packaging in which the goods are contained or wrapped. Example: Drums, Barrels, Pallets etc.

Res.Caption: Total Volume
Res.FullDescription: Enter the total volume of this shipment.

Res.Caption: Total Volume UQ
Res.FullDescription: Enter the total volume of this shipment

Res.Caption: Total Weight
Res.FullDescription: Enter the total gross weight of this shipment

Res.Caption: Total Weight UQ
Res.FullDescription: Enter the total weight of this shipment

Res.Caption: Mode of Transportation
Res.FullDescription: Indicates the mode of Transport used in the movement of the Cargo. For example: Air Cargo, Sea Cargo, Postal or Other.

Res.Caption: Voyage / Flight No
Res.FullDescription: A unique reference assigned by a carrier to identify a specific journey of an aircraft or vessel.
